Keep all hidden text when enabled

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'never' }, 'content' => { 'exclude_selectors' => [], 'extract_metadata' => false, 'keep_hidden' => true, 'preprocessing_preset' => 'minimal', 'remove_forms' => false, 'remove_navigation' => false }, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.markdown.content.inspect
```
